pairs.why: The two hats are almost the same: both are soft matte-satin black with clean brims and the same red band, so neither is clearly closer to the real cards.
The two are nearly identical in shape, finish and light, and both brims are built cleanly, so there is nothing real to choose between them.
A has a clean, even curled brim like the simple solid shapes on the real cards, while B's brim warps and dips unevenly at the front-right.
B's brim is clean and symmetrical, while A's brim has an odd fold on the left that makes it look less like a well-built object.
B's brim curls evenly and reads as one solid piece, while A's brim has a slight inward pinch at the back, so B looks more built like the real cards.
A's brim is smooth and even, while B's brim bends down unevenly on the right, which breaks the clean toy-like shapes of the real cards.
B has a clean, even brim, while A's brim warps on the right side; the finish on both is otherwise the same.
A's crown and brim are clean and even, while B's brim twists unevenly on the left, so A matches the simple, solid build of the real cards better.
